key_provisions_or_claims: Public fear of AI and robots is fuelled by Hollywood films; real robots are more likely innocently dangerous than malevolent.
Foundation for Responsible Robotics aims to engage policymakers and the public on robot ethics and societal hazards.
Sharkey warns of mass unemployment and inequality from robotics and that governments pay only lip service to societal hazards.
OpenAI seeks open access to advanced AI to reduce the risk of AI haves and have nots.
Scientists should participate in policy debate and move from empirical to normative questions.
annotation.summary_en: The Conversation article by a robot-ethics doctoral candidate arguing that public fear of AI and robots is exaggerated by Hollywood. It welcomes the launch of the Foundation for Responsible Robotics and OpenAI as efforts to engage policy, ethics and open access, and urges scientists to join policy debate.
annotation.title_clean: The drive towards ethical AI and responsible robots has begun
